name: toitoi-monorepo
description: ToiToi - Platform for Used Toy Trading & Repair Services

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../ai-module && pip install -r requirements.txt

author: ToiToi Team
